	This high-quality optical honey refractometer with automatic temperature compensation is designed for the easy, quick and accurate measurement of the water content in honey within a range of 13% – 25% with a resolution of 0.1%. A refractometer is an instrument for measuring the refractive index of a light beam, which can be used to determine the composition of liquid mixtures or the purity of substances. The refractometer is used wherever it is necessary to determine the quality of honey, or more specifically, its water content. Using the honey refractometer is very simple. Just place a drop of honey on the slanted optical prism of the device, close the prism cover (the honey will spread out), look through the eyepiece towards a light source, focus if necessary, and check the scale. You can immediately read the water content value in the honey in the field of view, based on the boundary between the illuminated and unilluminated parts.
